cases.name: CHK-001 happy: same session testintent_check still advances to TEST
cases.execute: const { mkdtempSync, mkdirSync, rmSync } = await import('fs'); const { tmpdir } = await import('os'); const { join } = await import('path'); const { StoryStore } = await import($root + '/packages/main/dist/core/store.js'); const { createChecklistHandlers } = await import($root + '/packages/main/dist/handlers/checklist.js'); const root = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'koala-owner-happy-')); try { mkdirSync(join(root, 'docs', 'story', 'actives'), { recursive: true }); const store = new StoryStore(root); const now = new Date().toISOString(); store.writeStory('B-test', { storyId: 'B-test', name: 'ownership', title: 'ownership', description: 'ownership', type: 'bug', phase: 'TEST_CASE_REVIEW', priority: 'high', createdAt: now, startedAt: now, endedAt: null, events: [{ phase: 'DEV', action: 'advance', timestamp: now, sessionId: 'sess-owner', agent: 'main', user: 'Owner' }] }); store.writeChecklist('B-test', { items: [{ id: 'CHK-001', title: 'x', status: 'done', startTime: now, endTime: now, testIntent: { happy: [{ desc: 'x', type: 'cli_blackbox', results: [{ time: now, role: 'reviewer', pass: true, note: 'ok' }] }], edge: [{ desc: 'x', type: 'cli_blackbox', results: [{ time: now, role: 'reviewer', pass: true, note: 'ok' }] }], adversarial: [{ desc: 'x', type: 'cli_blackbox', results: [{ time: now, role: 'reviewer', pass: true, note: 'ok' }] }] } }] }); process.env.KOALA_ACTIVITY_SESSION = 'sess-owner'; const handlers = createChecklistHandlers({ store, root, scanRoot: root }); const result = handlers.testintent_check({ storyId: 'B-test' }); const story = store.readStory('B-test'); return { advancedToTest: story.phase === 'TEST', allPass: result.allPass === true }; } finally { rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true }); delete process.env.KOALA_ACTIVITY_SESSION; }

cases.name: CHK-001 edge: missing current session degrades instead of ownership block
cases.execute: const { mkdtempSync, mkdirSync, rmSync } = await import('fs'); const { tmpdir } = await import('os'); const { join } = await import('path'); const { StoryStore } = await import($root + '/packages/main/dist/core/store.js'); const { createStoryAdvanceHandlers } = await import($root + '/packages/main/dist/handlers/story-advance.js'); const root = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'koala-owner-edge-')); try { mkdirSync(join(root, 'docs', 'story', 'actives'), { recursive: true }); const store = new StoryStore(root); const now = new Date().toISOString(); store.writeStory('B-test', { storyId: 'B-test', name: 'ownership', title: 'ownership', description: 'ownership', type: 'bug', phase: 'TEST', priority: 'high', createdAt: now, startedAt: now, endedAt: null, events: [{ phase: 'DEV', action: 'advance', timestamp: now, sessionId: 'sess-owner', agent: 'main', user: 'Owner' }] }); delete process.env.KOALA_ACTIVITY_SESSION; const handlers = createStoryAdvanceHandlers({ store, root, scanRoot: root }); try { await handlers.story_advance({ storyId: 'B-test', phase: 'DONE' }); return { blockedByOwnership: false, failedForChecklist: false }; } catch (error) { const text = String(error.message || error); return { blockedByOwnership: text.includes('不允许跨 session'), failedForChecklist: text.includes('DONE Gate Checklist') || text.includes('Test evidence') || text.includes('Story summary') }; } } finally { rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true }); delete process.env.KOALA_ACTIVITY_SESSION; }

cases.name: CHK-001 adversarial: cross-session DONE is blocked with takeover hint
cases.execute: const { mkdtempSync, mkdirSync, rmSync } = await import('fs'); const { tmpdir } = await import('os'); const { join } = await import('path'); const { StoryStore } = await import($root + '/packages/main/dist/core/store.js'); const { createStoryAdvanceHandlers } = await import($root + '/packages/main/dist/handlers/story-advance.js'); const root = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'koala-owner-block-')); try { mkdirSync(join(root, 'docs', 'story', 'actives'), { recursive: true }); const store = new StoryStore(root); const now = new Date().toISOString(); store.writeStory('B-test', { storyId: 'B-test', name: 'ownership', title: 'ownership', description: 'ownership', type: 'bug', phase: 'TEST', priority: 'high', createdAt: now, startedAt: now, endedAt: null, events: [{ phase: 'DEV', action: 'advance', timestamp: now, sessionId: 'sess-owner', agent: 'main', user: 'Owner' }] }); process.env.KOALA_ACTIVITY_SESSION = 'sess-other'; const handlers = createStoryAdvanceHandlers({ store, root, scanRoot: root }); try { await handlers.story_advance({ storyId: 'B-test', phase: 'DONE' }); return { blocked: false, mentionsTakeover: false }; } catch (error) { const text = String(error.message || error); return { blocked: text.includes('不允许跨 session 直接推进到 DONE'), mentionsTakeover: text.includes('KOALA_ALLOW_SESSION_TAKEOVER=1') }; } } finally { rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true }); delete process.env.KOALA_ACTIVITY_SESSION; }
